summary: The card's Evaluation results section swapped benchmarks: the ExtractBench block, which listed Mean, Short and Medium entries without figures, and the SWE-bench Pro entry were removed, and a ParseBench block was added reporting Mean 70.79, Text Content 88.28 and Text Formatting 59.77 for the qwen3_8_27b_thinking_parse_with_layout pipeline on the Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 checkpoint, plus a Terminal-Bench 2.1 entry.
justification: Substantive change: three new quantitative ParseBench results were published on the card and two previously declared benchmark entries were withdrawn. Download-count movement in the same diff is extraction noise and is excluded from the summary.
